what: Section 7.2 as a table: the seven cases the embedded PEP (xacml.js enforce()) and the remote PEP (rust/bins/xacml-pep) are both held to — the two decisions the biases agree on, the two they differ on, and the obligation rule on each side. tests/xacml_pep.js asserts the embedded one against this file, and the Rust crate's own test asserts the remote one, so two implementations are checked against one expectation.
